mapper.insert: INSERT INTO id_privacy_export ( request_id, user_id, nonce, cipher_text, expires_at, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{nonce}, #{cipherText}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), nonce = VALUES(nonce), cipher_text = VALUES(cipher_text), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), created_at = VALUES(created_at), deleted = 0
